<!-- pr-reviewer: 9d11b0ae51913bcd5fea6de2e7a95047bfe26435 -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes toolpath geometry: the ring order and the run-on lap of the 5-Axis Contour (`waterline_seamed`, `emit_rings_seamed`).

### What looks good

- The seat and the run-on are in the ring loop. Thus the column law, the hop, the stamp, the tilt limit and the centre-cutting guard all read the seated path.
- `None` keeps the old path. `contour5d_without_a_pick_is_the_automatic_ladder_byte_for_byte` pins this, and the example catalog and `golden_cl` suites are green. No recorded program changed, and the body says "Goldens moved: None".
- The production code is correct. I read `seat`, `run_on` and `nearest` index by index: the ring rotation, the lap `poly[1..=i]` and the tie rule are correct.
- The refusals give the pick by name. `PathPicks::refusal` already refuses more than one pick of each role.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. The new module has a provenance line. The decision file is present. No new crate edge. No new top-level test binary.
- The picks go to the generator in the S frame, as for the 2D Contour and the Slot. The Contour5D arm has no tilt, so L = S.

### Results (local Mac, trial merge with upstream/main `baad348f1`; the PR head already contains it)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 215 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (20.1 min). This includes `motion suites: multiaxis`, `app suites: start_exit_shared`, `center_cut_multiaxis`, `golden_cl`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (6.1 min).
- Pinning tests by name: the four `contour5d_*` tests in `motion multiaxis` and the three new tests in `app start_exit_shared`: pass.
- Extra suites run: none apply. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code.
- Heavy lanes: not run. The PR is not P1 (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review").

### Mutations (motion `multiaxis` contour5d pins; app `start_exit_shared` contour5d pins)

| # | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `rings.rs:403-404`: the seat does not set `entry` and `walk` | RED (`contour5d_start_point_seats_every_ring_at_the_pick`, `contour5d_exit_point_ends_every_ring_at_the_pick`) |
| 2 | `ring_seam.rs:413`: `poly.extend(lap)` removed | GREEN in motion and in app |
| 3 | `rings.rs:584`: the exit retract column check removed | GREEN |

### Requested before merge

1. **The exit pins do not see a gouge chord** (`crates/motion/tests/multiaxis.rs:703` `cuts_ride_the_ladder`, and `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs:161` `rings`).
   - Mutation 2 removes the run-on lap. Each ring then ends with one straight feed move from the start seam (+X) to the exit point (+Y), at ring depth. On the test dome, that chord passes about 9 mm from the axis, inside a ring of ball centres at about 13 mm. The ball cuts into the part.
   - All seven new pins stay green. The reason: `cuts_ride_the_ladder` checks only the END point of each move, and `rings` checks only the first and the last point of a run. The exit point is on the ladder, so the chord passes.
   - Class: the law "the cut geometry does not change" is checked only at move end points. Please close the whole class with one rule. Sample each cut move along its length (for example `segments3` at a small step), and require each sample to be on the automatic ladder within `TOL`. Use the same rule in the app pin, or assert there that no feed move of a seated ring is longer than the longest move of the automatic ring.
   - Confirm that mutation 2 is then red.
2. **The exit retract column refusal has no pin** (`crates/motion/src/finishing3d/rings.rs:584`).
   - This check is a new collision law. If it is removed (mutation 3), a retract through an overhang above the exit point passes silently. No test is red.
   - The body names this under "Not exercised". The start-side refusal is different: without it, the loop falls back to the old rotation to a clear vertex, which is safe. The exit side has no such fallback.
   - Please add one fixture where an overhang stands above the exit point. A small canopy beside the dome is sufficient. Assert the by-name refusal `exit point (x, y): the retract column from the ring at z ... crosses the part there`, and confirm that mutation 3 is then red.

### Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/rings.rs` has about 575 lines. It was over 400 lines before this PR, and the PR adds 4 net lines. A split along the seam/ring seam is a follow-up.
- `nearest` (`ring_seam.rs:339`): when the exit projection falls on the closing vertex, rounding can select the last segment at `t = 1` instead of segment 0 at `t = 0`. Then the run-on re-traces one more full lap. This is safe (it cuts air over cut material), but it costs cycle time. A snap of `t` near 1 to the next segment would prevent it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Reply to the review of `9d11b0ae5`. The new head is `fdce232c8`. It waits for a fresh review.

### Finding 1: the exit pins do not see a gouge chord

- Commit `294362eb7` (motion) and commit `e344b7aba` (app) close this finding.
- Motion: `cuts_ride_the_ladder` now samples each level cut every 0.25 mm (`segments3`, then steps of 0.25 mm). Each sample must sit on the automatic ladder within `TOL`. Before, the rule read only the end point of each move.
- App: `contour5d_starts_at_the_picked_start_and_leaves_at_the_picked_exit` uses the same rule. Each level cut of the started ladder and of the picked ladder is sampled every 0.25 mm. Each sample must sit within the 0.1 mm operation tolerance of the automatic ladder.
- Mutation 2 (`poly.extend(lap)` removed) is now RED in the two crates:
  - motion `contour5d_exit_point_ends_every_ring_at_the_pick`: "a cut stands 0.165 mm off the automatic ladder".
  - app `contour5d_starts_at_the_picked_start_and_leaves_at_the_picked_exit`: "a cut stands 0.160 mm off the automatic ladder".
- The #3330 pins moved into modules of their suites, so the files stay under 400 lines: `crates/motion/tests/multiaxis/seam.rs` and `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/contour5d.rs`. No new test binary.

### Finding 2: the exit retract column refusal has no pin

- Commit `294362eb7` closes this finding.
- Through `waterline_seamed`, a canopy above the exit point cannot reach this check. The column trim (`rings_overhang::trim_blocked_columns`) checks the same column, up to the same top, every 0.25 mm, at an equal or larger radius. Thus the trim opens each ring under the canopy first. The exit pick then has no closed ring and is refused by name. The new test `contour5d_exit_point_under_a_canopy_is_refused_by_name` (motion `multiaxis`) pins this for `waterline_seamed` and for `contour5d_seamed`.
- The exit column law is the only guard on a ladder without the trim (`emit_rings_with_trim(.., false)`, the ladder that the 5-axis swarf keeps). The new lib test `finishing3d::ring_seam_tests::exit_retract_column_through_a_canopy_is_refused_by_name` drives `emit_rings_seamed` with the trim off, a dome and a canopy block above the exit point. It asserts the refusal `exit point (0.000, 13.000): the retract column from the ring at z ... crosses the part there`. The same ladder with the start pick only cuts, so the canopy does not block the start side.
- Mutation 3 (the exit retract column check removed) is now RED: `exit_retract_column_through_a_canopy_is_refused_by_name`.

### Note: `nearest` at `t = 1`

- Done in commit `294362eb7`. `nearest` now states a foot at the end of a segment as the start of the next segment. The closing vertex is then segment 0, and the run-on adds no lap.
- Pin: `finishing3d::ring_seam_tests::nearest_states_a_segment_end_as_the_next_segment`. Mutation 4 (the snap removed) is RED.
- `rings.rs` is not split in this PR.

### Merge of main

The PR conflicted with main. Commit `f6a40b15c` merges `origin/main`. One conflict in `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`: the Gate map header (both lines kept) and one panic text (main's text kept). No logic conflict.

### Gate on `fdce232c8` (local Mac)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 215 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (29.1 min). This includes `motion suites: lib`, `motion suites: multiaxis`, `app suites: start_exit_shared`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (6.1 min).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean (on `e344b7aba`; the last commit changes only the decision file).
- Heavy step: none (P2).

Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: fdce232c8897dca74b8d117ce903c2dd9062e6f1 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (This is a `feat` PR: by AGENTS.md it merges at the next cut.)

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review. The PR changes toolpath geometry of the 5-Axis Contour (the ring seam and the run-on lap). The fix commits also change production code: `nearest` in `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/ring_seam.rs`.

### Earlier findings (review of `9d11b0ae5`)

1. **The exit pins did not see a gouge chord.** Fixed.
   - `294362eb7` and `e344b7aba`: `cuts_ride_the_ladder` in `crates/motion/tests/multiaxis/seam.rs` and in `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/contour5d.rs` now sample each level cut every 0.25 mm. Each sample must be on the automatic ladder.
   - I ran mutation 2 again (`poly.extend(lap)` removed). It is now RED in motion (`seam.rs:54`) and in app (`contour5d.rs:147`).
2. **The exit retract column refusal had no pin.** Fixed.
   - `294362eb7`: `finishing3d::ring_seam_tests::exit_retract_column_through_a_canopy_is_refused_by_name` puts a canopy above the exit point on the untrimmed ladder. It asserts the by-name refusal.
   - I ran mutation 3 again (the exit `column_clear` check off, `rings.rs:557`). It is now RED (`ring_seam_tests.rs:105`).
   - `contour5d_exit_point_under_a_canopy_is_refused_by_name` also pins the production path: there the column trim opens the ring first, and the exit pick is refused by name.
3. **Note on `nearest` (the extra lap at the closing vertex).** Fixed in `fdce232c8`/`294362eb7`. A foot at `t` near 1 is now the start of the next segment.
   - I read the change index by index. For `k = 0`, `poly[1..=0]` is an empty slice, so no lap is added and no panic is possible. For other `k`, the lap and the foot are the same points as before. `seat` gives the same ring as before after `dedupe`.
   - A path without a pick does not call `nearest`. `contour5d_without_a_pick_is_the_automatic_ladder_byte_for_byte` stays green.
   - Mutation 4 (the snap off): `nearest_states_a_segment_end_as_the_next_segment` is RED.

### Results (local Mac, trial merge of `fdce232c8` with upstream/main `138a592a1`)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 215 steps, 0 failed.
  - The motion part ran as one gate run: 36 steps, 0 failed (3.8 min).
  - The app part ran as one gate run. The tool time limit stopped it in its last step. All 177 earlier step logs have `test result: ok`. I ran the two last steps (`wcs_start`, `wire_post`) again by name: pass.
  - The plan includes `motion suites: multiaxis`, `app suites: start_exit_shared`, `center_cut_multiaxis`, `golden_cl` (34 pass), `example_catalog` (43 pass), `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`.
- Pinning tests by name: `multiaxis -- contour5d` 6 pass; `camcraft-motion --lib ring_seam` 2 pass; `start_exit_shared` 15 pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Extra suites run: none apply. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code.
- Heavy lanes: not run. No heavy record names this head. The heavy lanes are not a merge condition.
- Goldens moved: none. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changed. This agrees with the body.

### Mutations

| # | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | `ring_seam.rs:153`: `poly.extend(lap)` removed | RED (motion `seam.rs:54`, app `contour5d.rs:147`) |
| 3 | `rings.rs:557`: the exit retract column check off | RED (`ring_seam_tests.rs:105`) |
| 4 | `ring_seam.rs:87`: the foot snap at `t` near 1 off | RED (`nearest_states_a_segment_end_as_the_next_segment`) |

### Law check

- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. The new test modules have a provenance or purpose header.
- No new crate edge. No new top-level test binary: the new files are modules of `multiaxis` and `start_exit_shared`, and a `#[cfg(test)]` module of `finishing3d`.
- The decision file records the review follow-up.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Refs #3330` (a first slice, so the issue stays open).
- No UI change, so no screenshots are necessary. No process file changed.

### Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/rings.rs` has 574 lines. It was over 400 lines before this PR. A split is a follow-up (P7).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Left for the maintainer: feat PR (feat(multiaxis): start and exit picks for the 5-axis contour, P2) - waiting for the cut. Clean counted review at head fdce232c8 (mkinney, SAFETY-tier re-review, no blocking findings); MERGEABLE; not a P1 safety-floor PR. Maintainer merges by hand at the cut.
